capabilities: create a skill note for each skill
link skills to the notes they are built from
browse the full tree of foundations for a selected skill
mark progress with colored states such as Learned or Planned
filter and style the view via gear settings
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; controls and states are configured through a gear menu described as working like the core graph.
problem: Obsidian has no focused view for breaking a skill down into hierarchical foundations and tracking progress on each part.
summary: Builds skills as a tree of foundation notes, with a graph overview, colored progress states and quick creation of foundations.
